map.→ 打开质量（标准/评估/改进）体系工具: -> Open the quality (standard / assessment / improvement) system tool
map.从 5 个维度（每项 1-5 分）评估养老服务质量并输出总分（5-25）与改进方: Assesses eldercare service quality across 5 dimensions (each 1-5) and outputs a total score (5-25) with directions for improvement, for institutional quality assessment and continuous improvement.
map.养老服务机构质量自评中，按服务响应、专业能力、服务规范、满意度、安全管理五维打分: In the quality self-assessment of eldercare service organisations, score five dimensions: service response, professional capability, service standards, satisfaction and safety management.
map.哪一维低分最该优先改？: Which low-scoring dimension should be fixed first?
map.均值用于判定优秀/良好/一般/不合格，并定位需改进维度。: The mean decides excellent / good / average / fail and locates the dimensions needing improvement.
map.安全管理和服务规范通常与事故风险直接相关，单维≤2 即触发整改；建议先补齐安全制: Safety management and service standards usually relate directly to accident risk, so a single dimension at 2 or below triggers rectification; fill in the safety rules and standard processes first, then work on capability and satisfaction.
map.按五维均值：≥4.5 优秀、≥3.5 良好、≥2.5 一般、<2.5 不合格（满: By the mean of the five dimensions: 4.5 and above is excellent, 3.5 and above good, 2.5 and above average, below 2.5 a fail (maximum 25, each dimension 0-5). A failing result requires immediate rectification and a re-check by a deadline.
map.算例：五维均评 3 分: Worked example: all five dimensions scored 3
map.算例：五维均评 5 分: Worked example: all five dimensions scored 5
map.质量改进闭环：达标维度保持，≤2 分维度列入整改。: Quality improvement loop: keep the dimensions that pass and put any dimension scoring 2 or below into rectification.
map.质量等级怎么划分？: How are the quality grades divided?
map.：总分 = 15，均值 = 3.00 → 『质量一般』，需制定改进计划、加强培训: : total = 15 and mean = 3.00 give "average quality", requiring an improvement plan, stronger training and process optimisation (the mean 2.5-3.5 band).
map.：质量总分 = 25 / 25，均值 = 5.00 → 『质量优秀』，建议总结经: : a quality total of 25 / 25 with a mean of 5.00 gives "excellent quality"; it is recommended to summarise and share the experience and keep the standard.
